title: The exact column texture: tree-level Yukawa universality in heterotic $Z_3 \times Z_3$ orbifolds
summary: On $T^6/(Z_3 \times Z_3)$ heterotic orbifolds where three quark generations arise from $Z_3$ fixed-point triplication, we prove that the leading-order tree-level Yukawa amplitude -- the three-point coupling among massless string states -- has an exact column texture: $Y_{\rm lead}(i,j) = c\,\varepsilon^{q_R[j]}$, with the $O(1)$ coefficient $c$ universal across all left-handed generations $i$.
